author: National Geographic
description:
Join National Geographic to explore Egypt, with the 'World's Greatest Explorer', Sir Ranulph Fiennes and his cousin, actor Joseph Fiennes, star of Shakespeare in Love, The Handmaid's Tale, and recently  in Young Sherlock. On the second leg of their journey, the explorers spend a night inside the only surviving Wonder of the Ancient world - the Great Pyramid of Giza. They also traverse the wild Eastern Desert to the Red Sea. 

Egypt with the World's Greatest Explorer | S1 E2
